import pandas as pd
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', None)
pd.set_option('display.width', 250)

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%Y')
df['dow'] = df['date_dt'].dt.dayofweek  # 0 = Monday

anom_date = pd.Timestamp('2025-10-13')
print("day of week:", anom_date.dayofweek)

# Compare 10/13 vs other Mondays
mondays = df[df['dow']==0]['date_dt'].unique()
print("Mondays:", sorted(mondays))

for dim in ['cloud_service','application','instance_family','csp']:
    print(f"\n=== {dim} ===")
    piv = df.pivot_table(index=dim, columns='date_dt', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum')
    monday_cols = sorted([d for d in piv.columns if d.dayofweek==0])
    sub = piv[monday_cols]
    sub['mean_other_mondays'] = sub[[c for c in monday_cols if c != anom_date]].mean(axis=1)
    sub['anomaly_day'] = sub[anom_date] if anom_date in sub.columns else 0
    sub['diff'] = sub['anomaly_day'] - sub['mean_other_mondays']
    sub = sub.sort_values('diff', ascending=False)
    print(sub[['mean_other_mondays','anomaly_day','diff']].head(15).to_string())
